status.reason: No retained forest source has production-qualified B1/B2 truth. This contract first determines whether Hovi can become an R1 research-trainable weak surface, then permits one bounded weak-evidence model experiment without pretending that research output is truth, transfer, or a production owner.

claim_domain.name: single_valued_hemiboreal_forest_floor
claim_domain.destination: Estonia cells that later satisfy a physical-analogue dossier and an exact condition predicate

allowed_uses: measure direct support and observation disagreement
fit research-only B1 exemplars only after B1 qualification
evidence_units.known_failure: The 4096-cell full-scan central shard has 234 sole candidates, 2550 competing candidates, 1312 unresolved or overflow cells, and no accepted surface semantics.

allowed_uses: develop and calibrate a geometry-only semantic exclusion model on train1-4
one frozen semantic audit on test1-2

surface_contract.heightfield_meaning: top of the persistent, ground-connected, single-valued walking surface at observation time
heightfield_owned_when_directly_labeled_: peat or persistent organic horizon top
continuous ground-attached moss or nonvascular mat
hard_ownership_unknown: positive forbidden, water, dynamic, object, or non-heightfield evidence
unlabeled Hovi or Evo sheet without unique connected disjoint-view consensus
missing common feature or fired transfer-shift detector
included_subclass_unknown: unregistered photo identity on a unique disjoint-view-consensus Hovi sheet
unresolved mineral-soil, moss, settled-litter, ground-bonded-root, or embedded-clast identity
prohibitions: Do not redefine all publisher ground labels as canonical terrain.
Do not erase roots, embedded clasts, stable moss, stable litter, or peat with a generic ground classifier.
Do not bake detached woody debris or living vegetation into the terrain heightfield.
Do not use the lowest return as a semantic decision.

semantic_exclusion_experiment.purpose: Determine whether a conservative geometry-only model can reject clearly non-surface points without claiming the remaining points are canonical surface truth.
common_features_only: local covariance eigenvalue ratios at radii 0.0625, 0.125, 0.25, 0.5, and 1.0 m
normal verticality and planarity at the same radii
height above a robust 1.0 m lower-envelope plane
point support count and nearest-neighbor spacing at the same radii
semantic_exclusion_experiment.model: sklearn HistGradientBoostingClassifier with learning_rate=0.05, max_iter=300, max_leaf_nodes=31, min_samples_leaf=64, l2_regularization=1.0, early_stopping=false, random_state=20260714, and inverse-fit-class-frequency sample weights
semantic_exclusion_experiment.fit: Fit once on complete train1-3 files. No random point split and no patch split.
semantic_exclusion_experiment.calibration: Partition train4 into fixed non-overlapping 8 m XY blocks. Over unique predicted-score thresholds, use 10000 deterministic block-bootstrap resamples with seed 20260714 and choose the largest accepted area whose 95th-percentile forbidden-class false-acceptance ratio is at most 0.02. If no non-empty set passes, stop.
semantic_exclusion_experiment.audit: Run test1 and test2 once after model, features, calibration, and output schema are content-addressed. Partition and bootstrap each file independently by the same rule and seed. The 0.02 upper-bound gate must pass on both; woody-debris results remain separate because the frozen audit contains only 1021 such points.
semantic_exclusion_experiment.cross_sensor_use: Apply the frozen model to Hovi and Evo only as a domain-drift and negative exclusion prior. It may hard-reject calibrated forbidden candidates but contributes zero positive confidence and never labels a canonical surface subclass. Nonzero Hovi R1 weight comes only from the frozen disjoint-view weak-geometry operator.
semantic_exclusion_experiment.cross_sensor_drift: For each feature and each radius, require Hovi/Evo accepted candidates to lie inside the train1-4 empirical 0.5th-99.5th percentile envelope. Any out-of-envelope feature invalidates that point. Report retained fraction by context; do not retune the envelope.
semantic_exclusion_experiment.terminal: semantic_filter_research_usable_only_if_both_frozen_audit_files_pass; otherwise R1_research_ineligible. Production remains target_evidence_insufficient in either case.

confidence_and_unknown_policy.confidence_unit: non-overlapping 8 m physical context, then site and campaign; points and overlapping windows are never confidence replicates
confidence_and_unknown_policy.semantic_acceptance: The frozen calibrated threshold supplies negative forbidden evidence only. Passing it supplies no positive confidence or subclass label.
confidence_and_unknown_policy.M_C: cells directly observed by both frozen view groups after only external water/dynamic/non-heightfield masks and before sheet selection
confidence_and_unknown_policy.G_C: subset of M_C with one connected unique sheet, no interpolation, complete F4 support, common-feature in-domain, and no positive forbidden/object/multi-sheet evidence

band_terms.b_A_b_B: independent F4 band residuals on the common eroded support of G_C

cell_terms.c_local_i: N_C/(N_C+d_i), with (N_C,d_i)=(0,0) defined as 1 and any other zero denominator as 0
cell_terms.c_view_i: min(n_A[i],n_B[i])/max(n_A[i],n_B[i]), or 0 when both counts are 0

confidence_and_unknown_policy.combination_semantics: Observed evidence fractions combined by a conservative minimum bottleneck, not multiplied independent probabilities.
confidence_and_unknown_policy.hard_zero: Any interpolation, positive forbidden, water/dynamic, non-heightfield, multi-sheet, missing-feature, transfer-shift, or hard ownership-unknown state sets w_i=0 and p_unknown=1.
confidence_and_unknown_policy.loss_weight: For other R1 cells the robust weak-geometry loss weight is exactly w_i; there is no p_unknown threshold.
confidence_and_unknown_policy.missing_measurement: null and blocking; never zero, smooth, average, nearest class, or inherited confidence
confidence_and_unknown_policy.ambiguous_measurement: Hard ownership ambiguity is invalid and propagated through all estimator and F4 support; included-subclass identity remains explicitly unknown for R1 only.
confidence_and_unknown_policy.interpolation: record its distance and error separately; it never creates direct support

support_and_transfer_operators.cell_acceptance: Hard ownership-unknown, forbidden, non-heightfield, multi-sheet, OOD, or interpolated cells have zero weight. A unique directly observed disjoint-view-consensus Hovi sheet may carry R1 weak-geometry weight w_i while p_semantic_subclass_unknown=1 and total_surface_error=null; it is never target truth or production support.

view_groups.hovi: Decode the 16 scanner-origin translations from the retained pose records, compute their median XY center, sort by (atan2(y-center_y,x-center_x), radial_distance, ordinal), and assign alternating sorted positions to groups A and B. Freeze that mapping before reconstruction. Both groups must directly support every audited context.
view_groups.evo: Source IDs are redundancy groups, not physical views. effective_view_count remains unknown and cannot satisfy the view gate.

support_and_transfer_operators.invalid_propagation: Dilate semantic, support, occlusion, plot-boundary, interpolation, water, and non-heightfield invalidity through the exact F4 footprint before any band loss.

F4.definition: separable east then north float64 factor-four filter using input indices 4*p-3 through 4*p+6

support_and_transfer_operators.R4: separable Keys cubic reconstruction with a=-0.5 and fine phases -3/8,-1/8,+1/8,+3/8
current_blockers: independent XY and Z control absent

split_and_leakage_rules: All windows, augmentations, derivatives, and nearby plots inherit their whole site's strictest role.

For HY_SPRUCE4 synthesis, snap 8 m blocks to the retained plot-local origin, hash (contract_id,block_x,block_y) with BLAKE2b-256, assign digest_byte0 modulo 10 values 0-5 to train, 6-7 to development, and 8-9 to untouched internal audit, then invalidate every target whose exact 1.875 m complete partition halo crosses a block boundary.
HY_SPRUCE4 and HY_PINE2 are one site and one campaign; HY_PINE2 is never an independent holdout.
Evo 1086 and 1065 share evo.2024; they are not two independent campaigns and neither may tune the Hovi converter.
ForestSemantic-MS train1-3 fit, train4 calibrates, and test1-2 are opened once for frozen audit only.
No ForestSemantic-MS test statistic may change features, model, threshold, surface semantics, or stopping rules.
JS_SPRUCE1 bytes remain uninspected until the complete preregistration is frozen; after opening, no method change is allowed.
Taevaskoda and LUKE never enter fitting, tuning, thresholding, candidate selection, or ownership.
Duplicate or overlapping geometry is detected by bounds, timestamps, point fingerprints, and nearest-surface hashes before split assignment.
Spatial patches are not independent samples for confidence intervals; context, site, and campaign are the reporting units.

first_algorithmic_experiment.name: semantic_gated_disjoint_view_surface_reconstruction
sequence: Freeze and audit the ForestSemantic-MS geometry-only exclusion model.

On HY_SPRUCE4 only, reconstruct the candidate walking surface independently from preregistered disjoint scanner-pose groups; hard ownership unknown remains invalid while included-subclass identity remains explicitly unknown and receives only the frozen R1 weak-geometry weight.
Forward-sample each reconstruction through the other groups' measured support and reconvert with the same operator.
Measure direct support, cross-view coherence, phase bias, weak-surface transfer gain, cross-signal, and within-campaign disagreement separately for B1 and B2; keep total survey error unknown.
Freeze the surface recipe and research synthesis preregistration before applying diagnostics to Evo 1086 and 1065; report both separately and as one campaign, never as truth.

Promote B1 only to research_trainable when direct non-interpolated support, both view groups, positive cross-view coherence, cross-signal above disagreement, the frozen M/G/S/N/min operator, at least 32 m2 weighted train area, Kish effective count at least 8 non-overlapping valid train windows, and at least one complete nonzero-weight valid window in each development and internal-audit split all pass. B2 remains research-ineligible and production qualification remains target_evidence_insufficient.

primary_estimator.name: semantic_gated_multiview_mode_consensus
primary_estimator.reference: Fit a Huber tangent plane in each 1 m cell from provisional surface candidates, then evaluate 6.25 cm cells in tangent residual coordinates. A missing 1 m reference invalidates its descendants.
primary_estimator.per_view_modes: For each physical scan and 6.25 cm cell, histogram tangent residuals in 0.01 m bins, convolve once with [0.25,0.5,0.25], retain local peaks with at least six points occupying at least three of four XY quadrants, and record the unsmoothed median height of each retained peak.
primary_estimator.cross_view_consensus: Cluster per-scan peak heights by complete linkage at 0.03 m. A candidate requires at least two scans from group A and two from group B. Accept only when exactly one cluster satisfies that rule and every competing cluster has less than half its scan support; otherwise emit unknown.
primary_estimator.output: Emit the median of contributing unsmoothed per-scan peak heights, contributing scan IDs, r_eff terms, semantic exclusion counts, competitor counts, and unknown reason. Do not interpolate holes.
primary_estimator.scope: Research reconstruction only; even a stable candidate remains non-truth until direct surface labels and independent XY/Z control exist.

first_algorithmic_experiment.cheapest_useful_comparison: Run the already-retained lowest-connected multiview candidate estimator under the identical accepted-observation and invalid masks. Compare support, forbidden-class acceptance, cross-view coherence, and B1/B2 transfer; corrected-only is the later synthesis control, not a substitute for this measurement comparison.
first_algorithmic_experiment.fallback_after_limit: Park this evidence bundle with all artifacts and resume the independent public-target tracks; do not expand Hovi decoder or test infrastructure.

research_only_synthesis_bakeoff.activation: Only after the first algorithmic experiment marks a band research_trainable under the normative spec. Production use still requires qualified_target_B1/B2 and a passing physical-analogue dossier.

first_candidate.reason: Forest-floor residuals are one-to-many and structurally multimodal. Canonical family D tests the highest-ceiling learned prior directly; a deterministic regressor averages variance, while exemplar transfer from one inspected site has an unacceptable copying ceiling.
first_candidate.target: canonical B1 residual from the accepted R1 weak surface; B2 loss and output are identically absent
first_candidate.conditioning: separate channels for reconstructed 1 m authority, R4 parent, gradient, Laplacian, direct support, semantic confidence, p_unknown, and available frozen Hovi condition evidence; absent mandatory channels are explicit masks
first_candidate.architecture: Use normative family D exactly: metric pixel-space v-prediction U-Net, no natural-image VAE or pretrained weights, 1000-step cosine schedule, 50 deterministic DDIM steps, and locked PRF/window fusion.
first_candidate.training: Use only research-trainable HY_SPRUCE4 B1 cells with 4 m x 4 m input/support windows, central 2 m x 2 m valid targets, batch size 8, and 1.875 m complete partition halo. Weight each valid target exactly by w_i; hard ownership-unknown, forbidden, non-heightfield, multi-sheet, OOD, and interpolated targets are zero. Preserve p_semantic_subclass_unknown=1 and total_surface_error=null. Train normative seeds 17,31,47 for 50000 updates without selecting by audit data.
first_candidate.geometry: Generate one absolute world-aligned master over model support, then crop packed LOD -2/-1; never synthesize per chunk.
first_candidate.bands: B1 research preview only. B2 is research-ineligible and structural-only under this contract; enabling it requires a new preregistration.

cheapest_useful_comparison.reason: It reuses the same accepted windows, conditioning, U-Net capacity, optimizer, and metric losses without timestep/noise machinery, isolating whether stochastic generation adds conditional variance rather than merely changing the backbone.
cheapest_useful_comparison.budget: One normative seed, 50000 updates; no architecture or threshold search.

required_control.definition: The same corrected structural authority with unresolved forest morphology set to zero.

parked_families.resume: only if multiple independent source sites make anti-copy and attribution envelopes meaningful
only if qualified per-class covariance, tails, and local-stationarity evidence exist
only after the diffusion ceiling is measured and target volume supports adversarial audit
only after an independently calibrated process/form owner exists

research_only_synthesis_bakeoff.no_owner_rule: The selected frozen recipe may become research_preview_candidate, never research_owner or production owner. production_owner remains null, release rows remain unchanged, and no survivor, tie, or production win may be claimed.

seam_and_composition_rules.global_identity: Use the canonical coordinate-keyed BLAKE2b-256 PRF and world-aligned inference lattice from the normative spec. Storage chunk coordinates never seed or select morphology.
seam_and_composition_rules.support_domain: Generate over the complete physical/process/model-support domain before cropping publication chunks.
seam_and_composition_rules.regime_transition: Each physical phenomenon has one owner. Blend only confidence for the same owner's applicability; never average two specialists claiming the same scale/phenomenon. Unknown on either side remains unknown unless a separately qualified smooth terminal applies.
seam_and_composition_rules.window_fusion: Enumerate every complete world-aligned support window influencing a sample, sort canonically, and fuse metric deltas in float64 before one absolute-master composition.
required_invariance: identical overlap bytes independent of worker count and task order
identical overlap bytes independent of requested AOI and enclosing chunk
no parent, apron, chunk, or regime-boundary discontinuity in height, gradient, or normal
no visible transition caused by expert identity

anti_copy_and_repetition_tests.exact_copy: Fail any D4-transformed generated 0.5 m or larger patch that is float-identical to a training patch outside corrected structural authority.
anti_copy_and_repetition_tests.nearest_training_attribution: For every generated patch, report the nearest training patch and normalized gradient-domain correlation. Fail if the generated-to-training upper tail exceeds the untouched-HY_SPRUCE4-block-to-training upper envelope; label this a block-level weak-surface test, never site validation.
anti_copy_and_repetition_tests.source_concentration: Report area and amplitude attribution by training block and patch. Fail if concentration exceeds the untouched-HY_SPRUCE4 block retrieval envelope or if a single patch is reused outside that envelope.
anti_copy_and_repetition_tests.periodicity: Compute 2D autocorrelation and radial/oriented PSD over the uncropped master. Any nonzero peak or line outside the untouched-HY_SPRUCE4 weak-surface 95% envelope fails.
anti_copy_and_repetition_tests.translation_collision: Generate two disjoint same-condition world domains. Repeated forms at identical relative offsets, repeated patch hashes, or chunk-periodic phases fail.
anti_copy_and_repetition_tests.null_comparison: A phase-scrambled descriptor-matched field may be rendered as a research null only. It can never become a production candidate or fill unsupported cells.

stopping_rules: If either frozen ForestSemantic-MS audit file violates the 0.02 forbidden-class upper-bound gate, stop semantic transfer and do not inspect JS_SPRUCE1.
If Hovi/Evo common-feature drift invalidates all useful direct support, stop rather than adding sensor-specific hidden features.
If direct metric surface labels, independent XY/Z control, or acquisition response remain absent, retain target_evidence_insufficient regardless of visual plausibility.
Evaluate B2 diagnostics separately but never promote or synthesize B2 under this contract; a B1 pass never implies B2.
Start with six non-overlapping 8 m contexts; add six only for confidence width and stop at 24. Inconclusive at 24 abstains.
Stop a candidate on forbidden semantics, copying, repetition, seams, invalid water/object ownership, or missing condition support before aesthetic ranking.
Two failed full real attempts or 16 focused engineering hours parks this track; preserve code and artifacts and advance another qualified target source.
No amount of internal metric success authorizes release without held-out user-visible ground-level acceptance.

immutable_preview_boundary.when_allowed: Only after a target-specific research artifact passes its frozen research gates; it remains explicitly non-production.
requirements: content-addressed recipe, inputs, model, outputs, and QA index
ordinary cook-side packed geometry only; zero browser synthesis
real WebGPU clean boot of the exact URL before user review
terrain, materials, grass, trees, plants, water, and probes sample the same packed surface
forbidden: binary-format or shader changes for this experiment

expected_terminal_after_first_experiment.success: B1 becomes research_trainable; then run pixel_space_conditional_diffusion_D against deterministic_regressor_R and corrected_only, freeze one recipe before final audits, and permit at most one immutable research preview candidate.
expected_terminal_after_first_experiment.failure: target_evidence_insufficient; park Hovi/Evo/FSM without model proliferation and continue independent public target acquisition.
